Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From f1946fbe8300e906c30491387e565f3b58d7f049 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alex Wang <alexw@nicira.com>
Date: Wed, 19 Mar 2014 10:42:08 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] ovs-rcu: Call ovsrcu_init() in ovsrcu_quiesce().

This commit fixes a bug introduced by 0f2ea848(ovs-rcu: New library.).
It is possible that ovsrcu_quiesce() is called before ovsrcu_init().
So, it is necessary to call ovsrcu_init() in ovsrcu_quiesce().

Signed-off-by: Alex Wang <alexw@nicira.com>
Acked-by: Ben Pfaff <blp@nicira.com>

diff --git a/lib/ovs-rcu.c b/lib/ovs-rcu.c
index ac4513b33..1843ef598 100644
--- a/lib/ovs-rcu.c
+++ b/lib/ovs-rcu.c
@@ -127,6 +127,7 @@ ovsrcu_quiesce_start(void)
 void
 ovsrcu_quiesce(void)
 {
+    ovsrcu_init();
     ovsrcu_perthread_get()->seqno = seq_read(global_seqno);
     seq_change(global_seqno);
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

**File: lib/ovs-rcu.c**
- A call to `ovsrcu_init()` was added at the beginning of the `ovsrcu_quiesce()` function. This ensures that the initialization of the RCU (Read-Copy-Update) mechanism occurs before any operations that depend on it.

### Relationships
The modification addresses a bug where `ovsrcu_quiesce()` could be invoked before `ovsrcu_init()`, potentially leading to undefined behavior. By adding the initialization call within `ovsrcu_quiesce()`, the patch ensures that the RCU system is properly set up before it is used, thus maintaining the integrity of the operations that follow.
